messages.content:
Passages:
[1] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Life Insurance and Disability]
GitLab provides company-paid Group Life and Disability Plans through Generali to protect you and your loved ones during unexpected life events. This comprehensive coverage ensures financial security when you need it most.

Eligibility Requirements

- All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
- Coverage effective from your hire date (90-day waiting period)

Coverage & Key Features

- Life Insurance coverage
- Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) benefits
- Short-term and Long-term Disability protection
- 100% employer-paid premiums
- [View complete plan details](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MBz0k5KkXC2GeITvh2uXNXjMJE07TU3_9MTp8N9MlwM/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.uewazgm9e8qx) and [policy documents](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jNFYcn2CLWHpPolvGTEz21FCQKIYBsbq/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access

[2] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Family & Life Transitions > Group Accident Insurance]
All Netherlands team members receive automatic accident insurance coverage at no cost, providing financial protection for you and your family.

Coverage & Key Features

* 2x annual salary for death or permanent disability due to accident  
* Maximum annual salary coverage: EUR 250,000  
* Flat EUR 50,000 coverage for interns  
* No enrollment required \- automatic coverage

How to File a Claim

* Complete claim form ([English](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1btOAO8HaIndD3rNyy2ZGM2v6pOqd5qet/view?usp=sharing) or [Dutch](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TXDy9-OHgifVUtBht_vWoQ8Vdnr59pMe/view?usp=sharing))  
* Send to [total-rewards@gitlab.com](mailto:total-rewards@gitlab.com) immediately  
* For death claims: submit at least 36 hours before funeral/cremation

Important Details

* Review policy terms ([English](https://drive.google.com/file/d/10zMEoicyznarbiT_sJbwdKoQOdJb2rNK/view?usp=sharing) or [Dutch](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11dIBfZoIEIavIBYg-gWu7iZUbSxrnPJd/view?usp=sharing))  
* Inform your spouse about this benefit

[3] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Supplementary Medical Insurance]
GitLab provides comprehensive supplementary medical insurance through AXA Health Insurance to enhance your healthcare coverage beyond the French social security system. This valuable coverage includes medical, vision, dental, and maternity benefits designed to support your health and wellness needs.

Eligibility Requirements

- All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
- Coverage begins from your hire date
- Spouse and children eligible for dependent coverage

Coverage & Key Features

- 100% employer-paid coverage for team members
- 66% employer contribution for dependent premiums
- Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage
- Maternity and preventive care benefits
- [View full policy details](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xfkzQXwiITrhJ0HJk9K-eTtSjLEONiNB/view?usp=sharing) and [additional coverage information](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lKcSkHJKpOaJwVFUgCQDWgOHyFRkSib8/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access

[4] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Time Off Policies > Sick Leave Support]
Comprehensive coverage when you're unable to work due to illness.

Leave Entitlement

* 100% salary for first 25 days
* 70% salary continuation for up to 104 weeks total
* GitLab complies with [Dutch local laws](https://business.gov.nl/regulation/reporting-employee-illness-recovery/) regarding sick leave. Local laws override any leave policy we have in the benefit of the team members

How to Report

* Select "Out Sick" in Workday

Employees of GitLab B.V. have further rights and responsibilities regarding sick time based on Dutch law, as written into their employment [contracts](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/people-operations/people-operations/employment_contracts/):

[5] [GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Life Insurance and Disability]
1. Visit the [Generali beneficiary designation portal](https://designation-beneficiaires.generali.fr/)
2. Use the [scheme/contract number](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12muwdp-9XvQGO8B2cCGoEfZ7-dU2BeMY8GivNcbJCDM/edit?tab=t.0) to access your account
3. Follow step-by-step instructions available in [French](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11iFBV6PkA7phsXXgtIyHa79DlKwrY0Oh/view?usp=sharing) or [English](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1VzjaQYxnDrAQ8Ax5I6Z4y0XytxjPHNKi/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=115600862362829120699&rtpof=true&sd=true)
4. Designate and update beneficiaries as needed

[6] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > CZ Collective Healthcare Policy]
GitLab partners with [CZ](https://www.cz.nl/zorgverzekering/collectieve-zorgverzekering?015418634) to offer discounted supplementary insurance rates through our collective policy.

Eligibility Requirements

* All GitLab Netherlands team members
* Can include dependents

Coverage & Key Features

* Discounted rates on supplementary insurance
* Direct payment to CZ via bank account
* Annual enrollment period (end of year)
* Not obligatory \- you can choose any approved provider

How to Enroll/Access

* Review enrollment instructions in the [Netherlands CZ Collective Policy document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1waw2rNECdmsinqqmtj4XNuL0zMQvFeyI17-0YBvKURM/edit)
* Visit the [GitLab CZ page](https://www.cz.nl/zorgverzekering/collectieve-zorgverzekering?015418634)
* Contact CZ directly at 088 555 7777 for questions

Important Dates

* Team members can enroll in the plans during the enrollment period at the end of each year
* Team members must cancel their old insurance before January 1 and enroll in new insurance before February 1\. The coverage will be retroactive to January 1
* For more details, review the [Changing Health Insurance](https://www.government.nl/topics/health-insurance/standard-health-insurance/changing-your-health-insurance) page on the Netherlands Government Website

Question: If I move from GitLab France S.A.S. to GitLab BV in the Netherlands, how does the life insurance coverage differ between the two entities?

Answer:
For GitLab France S.A.S., life insurance is provided through Generali with 100% employer-paid premiums, covering life insurance, AD&D, and disability, effective from the hire date with a 90-day waiting period [1]. For GitLab BV in the Netherlands, the handbook specifies automatic Group Accident Insurance providing 2x annual salary (capped at EUR 250,000) for death or permanent disability due to accident, but does not list a general life insurance plan [2].

Is every factual claim in the answer directly supported by the passages? Reply with one word: Yes or No.
